name: tool-toy-trash
description: Tool, Toy, or Trash? An agent skill that audits AI hardware from its product page.

plugins.name: t3-hardware-scoring
plugins.description: Classify a hardware product as Tool, Toy, or Trash. Brand-blinds the source material, scores it with three independent auditors working from fixed rubrics and verbatim evidence, revalidates high-risk findings with an Eagle Eye pass, and applies a safety veto in the final synthesis.
